tex_content.html:
The distributions $|\nabla l_\infty |^2e^{-l_\infty }$, $Re^{-l_\infty }$, and $|\partial _\tau l_\infty |e^{-l_\infty }$ are absolutely convergent in the preceding sense.
Proof

\sketch ↗ cor:l-function-gradient-bound ↗ claim:absolute-convergence-weighted-distribution The reduced-length estimates bound all three coefficients by a constant multiple of $\max (l_\infty ,1)$ on each compact time interval.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Absolute convergence of the Laplacian term]
